name: tldr
description: While switched on, after each long reply a small model picks the sentences you must not skip (decisions, warnings, questions for you, failures, things to do) and marks them inside the reply with ⚑, and a box above the prompt sums the reply up: Summary, Needs you, Next. One Haiku call per long reply. Off until /tldr on.

minChars.title: Shortest reply to sum up
minChars.description: Replies shorter than this many characters are left alone.
